newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent drifts sideways to lower after rally.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent drifts sideways to lower after rally.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures drifted sideways to lower over the morning as buying inpetus waned following an initial short-covering-led surge.
Traders said the rally was short lived and appeared spread trade-related with initial chart resistance hardly challenged as funds roll short positions forward.
By 1240 GMT the August Brent contract stood 12 cents up at $18.63 a barrel after bouncing off resistance at $18.77 in opening trade.
The funds activity saw Aug/Sept spread move into a small contango from around a 20-cent backwardation last week.
